How can I measure the ROI of voice AI in my restaurant?

Measuring ROI from restaurant voice AI uses three input variables: missed calls per peak night, average phone order value, and peak nights per week. A restaurant missing 10 calls per peak night at a $40 average order value across two peak nights per week loses $40 × 10 × 2 × 52 = $41,600 per location per year. This is the revenue-recovery side of the ROI calculation. Labor savings are calculated separately: hours per week spent on phone management × fully-loaded hourly cost × 52 weeks. The fixed monthly cost of the AI system is set against both. VOICEplug’s calculator at voiceplugcalculator.lovable.app runs this calculation using each operator’s own numbers. At Rusty’s Pizza, average check sizes also increased 12-25% from consistent AI upselling, adding a third revenue line to the ROI.
